value.rationale: Adsorption event regularity and its relationship to bound residence are directly observable in sticky active-particle experiments. The two critical rates separate count-overdispersion and cross-correlation sign—quantities not encoded by mean bound occupancy alone. The strict intermediate phase and model-independent slopes 1 and 2 at weak resetting give a physically meaningful, parameter-uniform classification, beyond simply computing a preassigned moment.
